summary: Frontend-only regression at 390x844 after 4 new features. 15 of 16 flows PASS: app loads; clear-all + delete now go through the custom confirm-dialog (previous Alert.alert web bug FIXED); Income (Paid/Pending) save; outstanding-pill appears with ₹2,500 and navigates to Income tab; Husk form correctly shows NUMBER OF TRIPS + COST PER TRIP with NO weight-per-trip field; husk auto amount = 3 * 1000 = ₹3,000.00; husk-production-summary shows 12 tons total → coir 3.00 / pith 9.00; manual amount toggle overrides to ₹3,200; Salaries/Current bill show NAME label + 'Employee name' / 'Bill name' placeholders; Maintenance shows DESCRIPTION + 'What was repaired?'; Dashboard totals correct (₹7,500 / ₹4,750 / net ₹2,750); ledger-search-input filters by name; income-chip-coir-bale + expense-chip-husk filter correctly; 'No matching' empty state shows on excluding search; edit + delete + calendar rows + export-month-button (present & enabled with activity, disabled when empty month) + day-detail-modal opening/closing all work; and AsyncStorage persists totals across a full page reload. ONE REGRESSION FOUND: the income-status-toggle badge on income rows does NOT flip the status on tap — clicking PENDING leaves it PENDING and the outstanding-pill total does not change. The Pressable's onPress appears to not fire on react-native-web in this row layout (repro on public preview, 2 independent runs). This is the only remaining issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping the PAID/PENDING badge on an income row does not toggle status. Badge text stays 'PENDING' after click and the outstanding-pill amount does not update. Repro: add income with status=pending → go to Income tab → tap the badge → badge text unchanged, pill still shows same amount. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:284-288 (Pressable inside <View style={s.cell}> inside a row View). Likely onPress not firing on react-native-web due to nesting/hitSlop or the parent's numberOfLines Text layout swallowing the tap. Suggest wrapping the badge in its own row (not inside the description cell) or using onPressIn / TouchableOpacity, or adding hitSlop and ensuring the pressable is positioned outside the numberOfLines Text.

integration_issues.flow: Overview outstanding-pill updates on badge toggle
integration_issues.issue: Because income-status-toggle onPress does not fire on web, the flow 'tap badge → status flips → outstanding recomputes' is broken end-to-end. Setting status inside the Add/Edit form DOES work (record-status-paid / record-status-pending are correctly persisted and the pill reflects them). Only the inline badge tap is broken.

action_items: Fix income-status-toggle: move the badge Pressable OUT of the same cell as the numberOfLines={2} description Text, or replace Pressable with TouchableOpacity, add hitSlop, and confirm onPress fires on react-native-web. After the fix, retest: (1) tap badge with PENDING → becomes PAID, (2) outstanding-pill disappears/updates, (3) tap again → back to PENDING and pill reappears.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is now 814 lines — over the 700-line threshold. Please split RecordForm, CalendarView, DayDetailModal, Ledger, Filters, ConfirmModal, Settings, and buildMonthHTML into files under /app/frontend/app/components/ for maintainability.
Expense.loads and Expense.trips are both written with the same value on save (index.tsx:341-342). Consolidate to a single canonical field (trips) and derive/deprecate loads.

displayDate uses new Date(isoString) which localizes to device TZ; safe here since all dates are stored as full ISO with time, but consider slicing to YYYY-MM-DD to avoid off-by-one on day boundaries in extreme timezones.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview: https://profit-calculator-111.preview.emergentagent.com. 390x844 viewport. AsyncStorage is per-browser-context so tests must add data in the same session before verifying calendar/day-details. Everything except the inline income-status-toggle badge tap is green. Repro for the bug: add income with status=pending in the form → switch to Income tab → tap the badge (testID=income-status-toggle) → observe badge text and outstanding-pill remain unchanged. Fix will most likely be small (move Pressable out of the cell view or replace with TouchableOpacity + hitSlop). After the fix, only re-verify: badge toggles + outstanding-pill updates + calendar/day-detail (already green) + reload persistence (already green).
rca_of_issue: The income row badge is a <Pressable testID='income-status-toggle'> that sits INSIDE the same <View style={s.cell}> that also holds a <Text numberOfLines={2}> describing the row. On react-native-web this layout intermittently swallows the tap because the Text and Pressable are stacked in a flex column cell and the Pressable is small (padding 3/7). Confirmed by two independent runs: onPress never invoked (badge text unchanged, outstanding sum unchanged, incomes state never re-set). Mitigation: (a) move the badge Pressable to its own <View> row below or beside the description; (b) or replace with <TouchableOpacity onPress={...} hitSlop={{top:8,bottom:8,left:8,right:8}}>. Setting status via the form works — this is only the inline shortcut.
